import json, sys, time, resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/emicro-deps'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/project')
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('drv','/workspace/project/driver.py')
drv=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(drv)
LIM={'images':16,'cells':262144,'units':1024,'contexts':32768,'connections':4096,'packets':32768,'files':8192}
SVC=[{'name':'S%d'%i,'label':i+1} for i in range(16)]
jobs=[]
for j in range(4):
    ev=[{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':'match(S0) allow;'},{'op':'commit','epoch':1}]

    jobs.append({'services':SVC,'limits':LIM,'events':ev})
data=json.dumps({'jobs':jobs}).encode()
t=time.time(); out=drv.solve(data); el=time.time()-t
usage=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF)
